MATERIAL_HALLUCINATION.definition: A factual claim that is materially relevant to the briefing but unsupported by the supplied evidence. Do not apply to omissions, harmless paraphrases, or issues already represented only by a lower rubric score.

PROHIBITED_ACTION.definition: Recommends an action explicitly contradicted or prohibited by the current state.

MAJOR_CONTRADICTION.definition: The response materially contradicts itself about the current state of an important issue.

false_actions.description: Treating the lunch discussion as relevant or actionable.
Re-opening or prioritizing the resolved icon discussion.
Treating Friday's completed partner sync as upcoming.
Assigning the Analytics v2 launch email to the user.
Treating Acme investigation as an active Monday task.
Treating sending proposed Enterprise pricing as a valid action.

penalty_rule: Only materially_misleading=true violations incur their defined points. Sum penalties, cap total magnitude at maximum_global_penalty; dismissed candidates incur zero.
noise_rule: If present, start at starting_points; subtract deduction_per_false_action for each triggered category, floor at minimum_points.
aggregation_rule: Use the frozen criterion label point mappings. Sum dimensions, then apply capped penalties with a final floor of zero. No points have been assigned in this package.
tie_rule: Choose the lower label when between two labels.
